findings.evidence: In the proof, the only uses of `hodd` and `Fintype` are in `have : NeZero (2 : F) := ...`, followed by `rw [nonempty_algEquiv_prod_iff, isField_iff_not_isSquare, nonempty_algEquiv_dualNumber_iff]; tauto`.
findings.fix: Add `QuadraticAlgebra.trichotomy {K} [Field K] [NeZero (2 : K)] (r : K) : Nonempty (_ ≃ₐ[K] K × K) ∨ IsField _ ∨ Nonempty (_ ≃ₐ[K] K[ε])`. Then derive the odd-cardinality finite-field version from it in one line.
findings.issue: `FiniteField.quadraticAlgebra_trichotomy` uses `Finite F` and `Odd (Nat.card F)` only to derive `NeZero (2 : F)`. The rest is `rw` with the three general iffs and `tauto`, so the theorem holds for every field with `2 ≠ 0`.

findings.evidence: The proof is `algEquivDualNumberOfDoubleRoot u` applied to the hypotheses `CharTwo.neg_eq` and `CharTwo.two_eq_zero`. Neither uses `Finite F`.
findings.fix: State a general lemma `[Field K] [CharP K 2] (hr : IsSquare r) : Nonempty (QuadraticAlgebra K r 0 ≃ₐ[K] K[ε])`, and get the finite version by supplying `FiniteField.isSquare_of_char_two`.
findings.issue: `nonempty_quadraticAlgebra_algEquiv_dualNumber_of_even_card` needs finiteness only to make `r` a square (`isSquare_of_char_two`). The construction is valid in any field of characteristic two in which `r` is a square.

findings.evidence: `isField_iff_not_isSquare` carries no characteristic hypothesis, and `not_isField_prod` is already in this file.
findings.fix: Restate the theorem as `[Field K] [CharP K 2] (r : K) : IsEmpty (QuadraticAlgebra K r 0 ≃ₐ[K] K × K)`, splitting on `IsSquare r`, and derive the finite-field version from it.
findings.issue: `isEmpty_quadraticAlgebra_algEquiv_prod_of_even_card` holds over every field of characteristic two. If `r` is a square, the algebra is the dual numbers, which are not reduced. If `r` is not a square, the algebra is a field (`isField_iff_not_isSquare`), and `not_isField_prod` rules out `K × K`. Restricting to even cardinality hides this.

findings.evidence: In `DualNumber.lean`, `not_isReduced : ¬IsReduced (QuadraticAlgebra R 0 0)` under `[Nontrivial R]`. Its proof is the same nonzero-nilpotent argument as the private lemma.
findings.fix: Derive it from `not_isReduced` via `isReduced_of_injective algEquivDualNumber.symm`, or drop it and use `not_isReduced` directly, as the even-cardinality theorem already does.
findings.issue: The private `not_isReduced_dualNumber` (stated over a field) re-proves a special case of the PR's own `QuadraticAlgebra.not_isReduced [Nontrivial R]`. The two are related by `algEquivDualNumber`.

summary: The trichotomy and the characteristic-two results are proved only over finite fields, although their proofs work over any field with `2 ≠ 0` or of characteristic two. A private lemma also re-proves the PR's own `not_isReduced` for a special case.
